scenario: Expressions are legal in `emit` slot-value positions per LEXP.8.3 / LEXP.8.4. Any arithmetic expression is valid as a slot value in an `emit` action. Pin: `emit Report logical val: s.raw / 10.0`, an Int slot divided by a Float into a Float slot, compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: no value is computed or emitted.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    raw: Int key

schema Report scope logical:
    val: Float key

rule r:
    Sensor s
->
    emit Report logical val: s.raw / 10.0
